applicability.rationale: Patients were randomized individually 1:1 to parallel early-surgery or conservative-care assignments.

relation_rationale: The primary endpoint is the requested composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up, in the randomized early-surgery versus conservative-care groups, analyzed by intention to treat from randomization through follow-up ending four years after the last enrollee.

reported.analysis_population: All randomized patients in an intention-to-treat analysis: 73 assigned to early surgery and 72 assigned to conservative care.

endpoint.name: Primary end point: operative mortality or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up

requested_outcome: Composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.method: Operative mortality (death during or within 30 days after surgery) or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up, adjudicated by an independent clinical-events committee.
measurement.metric: Composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up

target.outcome_definition: Composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up

time_point_or_window.description: From randomization through follow-up until four years after the last patient was enrolled; median follow-up was 6.2 years in early surgery and 6.1 years in conservative care.
